title: Cosmic Vortex Swirl
description: An abstract swirling vortex dominates the left and center of the image, composed of dark blues and purples with bright yellow and white specks. The right and bottom areas transition into a dense field of soft, out-of-focus circular bokeh-like orbs in greens, yellows, pinks, and teals against a dark background.
prompt: abstract digital painting of a powerful swirling vortex in deep indigo and purple tones with bright yellow glowing specks, transitioning into a vast field of soft out-of-focus circular bokeh orbs in greens, teals, and pinks, mysterious cosmic energy flow, painterly texture, atmospheric and dreamy
